data.body: Field evidence (validation of this fix's premise): two independent epic closes today hit the exact target failure class. (1) becoming-berserk-grunion close: completion verifier hit step budget (request_limit=24, 95s) and reported 2 ACs unmet that were satisfied on merged main (tests/unit/test_scan_scoping.py, e72e comment) — resolved only via [operator-attested] tags + re-verify. (2) The pony-epic session reports the same: budget exhaustion at 32 requests across 15 ACs failed 5 criteria that closed children already satisfy. Both are absence-of-evidence-rendered-as-refutation — precisely what the evidence_sufficient:false marker distinguishes. No design change needed; incidents confirm the bounded-fallback/marker approach.
